name: Acebedo (Spain)
description: Square flag divided diagonally by a yellow band from the upper hoist to the lower fly, red above and blue below, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Acebedo (a holly branch, a key and a sword).
history: Municipal flag of Acebedo; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: broad band from the upper hoist to the lower fly
